cards.text:
毕业好多年了，
你又坐回了考场
cards.en:
Years out of school,
and you're back in an exam.

cards.text:
卷子发下来，一个字都不认识，
这门课你一学期都没去过
cards.en:
Not one question makes sense.
You never went to this class.

cards.text:
笔没水，甩了三下还是写不出，
抬头看钟，二十分钟没了
cards.en:
Your pen is dry. Shake. Nothing.
The clock: twenty minutes gone.

cards.text:
你心里还在嘀咕：
等等，我不是早就毕业了吗？
cards.en:
Part of you protests:
wait, didn't I graduate?

cards.text:
然后你醒了，愣了好几秒，
才想起来：早就不用考试了
cards.en:
You wake up. It takes a moment:
right. No more exams.

cards.text:
可过一阵子，
它又来了
cards.en:
Months later,
it's back.

cards.text:
一百多年前，弗洛伊德
也老做这个梦。
cards.en:
A century ago, Freud
kept having it too.

cards.text:
他把它写进了《梦的解析》，
归在「典型的梦」里。
cards.en:
He put it in The Interpretation
of Dreams, as a “typical dream.”

cards.text:
奇怪的是，一位同行说，
只有当年考过的人才做这个梦，
cards.en:
Oddly, a colleague said
only those who passed get it;

cards.text:
真考砸了的，
反而不做。
cards.en:
those who really failed
never do.

cards.text:
弗洛伊德自己就是这样。
他挂过一门法医学，
cards.en:
Freud fit the pattern.
He once failed forensic medicine,

cards.text:
可这门课，
他一次也没梦见过。
cards.en:
but never once
dreamed about it.

cards.text:
他梦里考的，常常是植物学、
动物学、化学，
cards.en:
In his dreams, it was botany,
zoology, chemistry —

cards.text:
这几门当年他怕得要命，
最后靠运气、靠考官手软才过。
cards.en:
subjects he'd dreaded, and passed
on luck and a kind examiner.

cards.text:
它挑日子也有讲究：
常在第二天有件要紧事、
cards.en:
It picks its nights, too:
the night before something big,

cards.text:
你怕自己出丑的前一晚，
比如要述职，要面试，
cards.en:
when you could look foolish —
a presentation, an interview,

cards.text: 或者要去见对方的家长。
cards.en: or meeting their parents.

cards.text:
弗洛伊德说，梦里那份慌，
不是旧考试带来的，
cards.en:
Freud says the panic
isn't from the old exam.

cards.text:
是你白天揣着的
那件心事。
cards.en:
It's the worry
you carried all day.

cards.text:
他说，考场连着
小时候挨罚的那份怕；
cards.en:
Exams carry a kid's fear
of punishment, he says.

cards.text:
长大后，罚你的换成了生活，
所以肩上一有担子，
cards.en:
Grown up, life punishes instead,
so under pressure,

cards.text: 就会梦回考场。
cards.en: back to the exam you go.

cards.text:
但它不只是在吓你。
弗洛伊德对梦的根本看法是：
cards.en:
But it's not just scaring you.
Freud's core idea:

cards.text: 梦不是胡乱的噪音，
cards.en: a dream isn't random noise.

cards.text:
它会把事情，
演成你心里希望的样子。
cards.en:
It shows things
the way you'd wish them to be.

cards.text:
他说，吓人的梦也一样，
只是得看底下那一层。
cards.en:
Scary ones too, he says:
look underneath.

cards.text:
而你今晚最盼的，
无非是明天别出事。
cards.en:
And all you want tonight
is for tomorrow to go okay.

cards.text:
梦就去旧事里翻，
翻出一场你当年怕得要死、
cards.en:
So the dream digs up an old exam
that terrified you,

cards.text: 最后却什么事都没有的考试。
cards.en: and then came to nothing.

cards.text:
所以它只挑你考过的那场：
挂掉的那场，证明不了「别怕」。
cards.en:
So it only picks exams you passed;
a failed one can't say “relax.”

cards.text:
梦里那句
「我不是早就毕业了吗」，
cards.en:
And that line in the dream,
“didn't I graduate?” —

cards.text:
听着像抗议，弗洛伊德说，
其实是梦在安慰你：
cards.en:
sounds like protest. Freud says
it's comfort from the dream:

cards.text:
别怕明天，想想当年你有多怕，
后来什么事都没有。
cards.en:
Don't fear tomorrow. You were this
scared then, and nothing happened.

cards.text:
下次再梦见考试，
先别急着慌。
cards.en:
Next time it comes,
don't panic yet.

cards.text:
它多半是在说：
明天有件事，你很在乎。
cards.en:
It's probably saying:
something tomorrow matters to you.

cards.text:
明天那一关，
多半也会像当年那样过去。
cards.en:
Tomorrow will most likely
go the way that exam did.

cards.text:
所以笔没水也不要紧，
那张卷子，你早就交上去了。
cards.en:
So never mind the dry pen.
You turned that exam in years ago.
